text.p: National-Oilwell Inc said Monday it had tentative agreements to acquire PEP Inc and the Ross Hill Controls drilling business of Ansaldo Ross Hill.

National-Oilwell said it agreed to exchange an undisclosed number of common shares for PEP, a maker of a variety of drilling mud pump expendable components with an emphasis on replacement fluid end modules and ceramic liners for all major manufacturers' mud pumps.
The transaction is expected to be a tax-free exchange, National-Oilwell said, adding it is expcted to be closed by the end of May.
It said the Ross Hill business to be acquired for undisclosed terms involves the manufacture, sale and service of innovative electrical control systems used in conjunction with drilling operations.
Ansaldo Ross Hill is a subsidiary of Italy's Ansaldo SpA, one of the major European electro-mechanical manufacturers.
